scripts.build: pnpm run clean && rolldown -c && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.format: oxfmt --write "src/**/*.ts" rolldown.config.mjs vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check "src/**/*.ts" rolldown.config.mjs vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
